title: C28-A Portfolio-Level Cross-Venue Capital Allocation & Correlation Fidelity
why_c28: C24 established margin/liquidation fidelity (PASS, consolidated C24_REOPENS_C1_C23). C25/C26 adjudicate cost/funding and intrabar-path fidelity on the same four venues. C27 is the next-venue replication. C28 is the mandatory same-session successor on C27 PASS: it opens the portfolio/allocation/holdout/execution-realism fidelity frontier so the heavy-work queue never dries out and no session may claim 'no authorized work'. C28 may NOT launch until C27 ACCEPTANCE: PASS; C27 may NOT launch until C26 ACCEPTANCE: PASS; C26 may NOT launch until C25 ACCEPTANCE: PASS; C25 is IN FLIGHT.
research_question: Does the pooled spec-literal crash-rebound edge remain positive under the portfolio_level_allocation fidelity axis, across four real venues and four folds, with the signal path frozen and draw floors intact?
blocked_on: C27-T1 (next independent USDT-perp venue replication), which is itself blocked on C26, which is blocked on C25. C28 build (this prereg) may proceed before C25/C26/C27 pass, but no C28 cell may run until C27 ACCEPTANCE: PASS and the prior primary-arm evidence is available as anchor reference.

signal_path_frozen.drift_rule: Any artifact whose signal_path/cost/execution fields differ from this prereg are INVALID.

alloc_base.why: Equal-ish per-venue allocation reproducing the C25/C26 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL within +/-1.0 (ALLOC_ANCHOR_REPRODUCED). Baseline for the fixed-budget pool.

alloc_correlation.why: Cross-venue capital allocation under a fixed gross budget (gross_cap_pct applied to the pooled portfolio, per-venue caps, correlation-aware sizing). Tests whether pooled sign survives capital constraints + venue correlation.

liquidation.rule: Liquidation distance fixed at the C24 primary arm (d15: maint=14, buffer=1 => 15%); not a C28 variable.

arms_rule: ONLY the C28 direction axis varies across arms. All other config fields (signal path + liquidation distance + cost model + funding model) are identical and drift-checked. The FIDELITY_ANCHOR arm reproduces the prior primary-arm baseline within +/-1.0; the PRIMARY arm is the adjudication arm. All arms run the full 4 venues x 4 folds x 20k bootstrap / 20k permutation / 2k placebo — no smoke arm, no reduced draw floors, no descriptive-only arm.

inference.pooled: venue-blocked bootstrap over the venue-fold cell totals (20000 draws)

multiplicity.family: primary arm, 4 folds x 4 venues = 16 permutation tests

inference.power_floor: >= 10 trades / >= 5 episodes / >= 5 distinct crash days per fold; otherwise UNDERPOWERED with a power curve.

funding_acquisition.rule: A venue without realized funding history is recorded UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING (never zero-filled) and the realistic arms are evaluated on the remaining venues; okx is UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING by API retention (33-day window).

anchor_rule.rule: Anchor verification against the prior primary arm is mandatory BEFORE any C28 inference cell runs. The fidelity-anchor arm of the selected direction must reproduce the C25/C26 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL (or the corresponding C28-A/C28-B/C28-C baseline) within +/-1.0 (<AXIS>_ANCHOR_REPRODUCED). Anchor mismatch => C28_UNDERPOWERED; no verdict may be issued until the anchor reproduces.

decision_rules.C28_REOPENS_C1_C27: ALL of, under the PRIMARY arm of the selected direction: (a) pooled total PnL > 0; (b) venue-blocked bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0; (c) >= 1 BH survivor in the 16-test primary-arm family; (d) >= 3 of 4 folds positive; (e) >= 3 of 4 venues positive (available venue set). Then the C1-C27 NO_GO is NOT robust to the C28 fidelity axis: record SUPERSEDED_BY_C28 and the edge is re-opened.
decision_rules.C28_NO_GO_ROBUST_TO_AXIS: ANY of (a)-(e) fails under the PRIMARY arm. Then the NO_GO survives the C28 fidelity axis and is strengthened: record C1-C28 NO_GO ROBUST TO MARGIN, COST, PATH AND <AXIS>.
C28_UNDERPOWERED: Anchor mismatch, prereg generated after any compute artifact, draw floors not met, missing artifacts, signal-path/cost/execution drift, or acquisition gate not passed.

checkpoint_rule: A (direction, arm, venue, fold) is DONE only when research_state/c28_ckpt_<direction>_<arm>_<venue>_<fold>_<TS>.json exists. Resume with --resume; never relaunch completed folds.

provenance.caveat: Real exchange USDT-perp data, non-synthetic, CROSS-VENUE vs the Hyperliquid spec; NEVER Hyperliquid performance evidence and never relabelled as such.

guardrails: No synthetic gap-fill; no spec relaxation of RSI/target/hold/sizing/volume/gross cap.

Signal path frozen to the C24/C25/C26 sentinel; liquidation distance fixed at the C24 primary d15; cost model frozen at C25 primary; funding model honest (okx = UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING, never zero-filled or proxied).
No additional venues, folds, or directions beyond those pre-registered for the selected C28 direction.
Artifacts are immutable once written; do not edit completed campaign outputs.
No C28 cell runs until C27 ACCEPTANCE: PASS (sequential adjudication chain).
Draw floors (20k/20k/2k/2k) are not reducible. No reduced-draw runs.
No same-data rerun of a closed campaign; each C28 direction needs a new data manifest (holdout window or execution cache) + fresh prereg + anchor verification.
